text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: On a day off, while {0} was taking a walk, he spotted Sono in the midst of a crowd in the plaza.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日の休日、
{0}が散歩をしていると、
広場の人だかりの中にソノを見つけた。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeh? Why?! No way, no way, I wanna join toooo!! I mean... I'm wanpaku ( mischievous )! Very wanpaku!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
なんでー！？
やだやだ、
私もさんかすーるーのーっ！！
だって
私わんぱくなんだもんっ！！　
わんぱくっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: GAH!!? ...You-... O-Onii-chan...! Let's talk over there...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおっ！！？
……ちょ、
おにー
ちゃん……！
む、
向こうで
話そ……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: This is the worst. You've seen me in a most embarassing situation... Geez, what are you doing out here alone on a nice day off like this? ...Taking a walk? Ah, I see.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最悪だ。
めっちゃ恥ずいとこ見られた……
ったく
こんな天気のいい休日に
一人で何してんのよ。
……
散歩です？　
ああ、
そう。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Me...? I was thinking of entering this... The "Wanpaku Children's Festival" event...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私……？　
私は
これに出ようかと……
この
『わんぱくこどもフェス』って
イベントにね……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I-It's not like I want to take part in it...! My goal is to win the grand prize... I really want that golden bug net.
text_block_list.orig_text:
べ、
別に
出たいわけじゃないんだよ……！
私のお目当ては
優勝商品……
黄金の虫取り網が
ほしくってさ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Hm, well, that's about it. She's been acting like a good girl lately. I was planning to surprise her with it, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん、
ま、
そういうこと。
最近
あいついい子にしてるからさ。
サプライズで用意してやろうと思ってたんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Apparently, you need a guardian's consent to enter. *sigh*... I'm the one who's her guardian, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
参加するには保護者の同意がいるんだってさ。
はあ……
こちとら保護者だっつーのよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, I think that'd be fine, but... Ah, don't tell me you're planning on being my guardian...? ...Are you a god?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
そりゃ
まあ
いいと思うけど……
あ、
もしかして
君が保護者役を……？　
……神なのか？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry for interrupting your walk... But this'll be truly a huge help. Alright then, I’ll be your little sister, Sono-chan. I'm counting on you, Onii-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ごめんね散歩してたのに……
でも
助かるよ。
じゃ、
私は妹のソノちゃん
ってことでよろしく。
お願いね、
お兄ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thanks to your assistance, I managed to enter. To explain, this "Wanpaku Children's Festival" is a children's triathlon with a total of three events where you compete for the grand prize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
君のおかげでなんとかエントリーできたわ。
てことで、
この『わんぱくこどもフェス』は
合計３種目で
総合優勝を争う
お子様トライアスロンなわけよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Two of the events were revealed to the public... First, a big eating contest. Then, a Sumo tournament.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最初の２種目は公開されてて……
まずは
大食い大会。
次に
相撲。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: What's with that face? Well, I do get the feeling I understand what you're about to say...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにその顔は。
いやまあ、
言いたいことは
分かるよ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That's right. I mean, I'm more brains than brawn...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなのよ。
ほら、
私って頭脳派だからさ～……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, I guess? It is called "Wanpaku ( mischievous )", after all. It’s perfect for her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやまあ、
ね？
わんぱくってくらいだし、
あの子にピッタリなのはそう。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That said, I'm still up against a bunch of kids. Sorry to say, but it should be an easy win. Oh, it's almost time for the first event... Alright, I'm off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
相手は子どもよ。
みんなには申し訳ないけど
優勝は私が貰うわ。
っと、
そろそろ第一種目ね……
じゃ、
いってくる。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Wait... Huh?! A colorful sugar donuts... eating contest...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って……
はあっ！？
カラフルシュガードーナツ
大食い対決……！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: This embodiment of sugar and bright colors is absolutely poisonous to my body...! There's no way I can allow Iroha's body to eat something like thi-... Wait, the other kids have already started!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな着色料と糖質の権化、
絶対体に毒じゃん……！
こんなんイロハの体で食べるわけには……
って、
周りの子たち食べだした！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, it's all for the sake of victory. Iroha, I'm sorry. I'll be more careful about my health from tomorrow onwards, so, just for today... I'll be eating a lot of sugar!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うう、
優勝のためよ。
イロハ
ごめん。
明日からちゃんと健康に気をつけるから、
今日だけ
糖質にまみれるね……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Then... time to dig in!! *munch*.............*munch*......

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I mean, if I don't eat them slowly, the sugar in my blood will rise... *munch*... ...............*munch*........
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
ゆっくり食べないと
血糖値上がるから……
もぐ………………………………
もぐ………………………………

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I can't move. I'll never eat any kind of sweets for the rest of my life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
動
けない。
もう
一生甘いものは
勘弁だわ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I've a bit of stomach medicine... Phew. I couldn't pass on having some around before, but to think it'd come in handy when I'd be in a kid's body. It seems my old habit proved to be a lifesaver.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと胃薬……
ふう。
前は手放せなかったけど
子どもの体でもお世話になるとは。
惰性で持ってて
助かった。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Besides, it turned out to be a pretty good contest. The other kids were eating like crazy while guzzling down a lot of water, so I suppose they got full fairly quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
案外いい勝負だったな。
周りの子たち
ガンガン食べて、
お水がぶがぶ飲んじゃってたから、
あっという間にお腹膨れちゃったんだね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Good, one step closer to the bug net. Onii-chan! Sono will do her best in the next match, too! Now then, as for the second event...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
虫取り網に
一歩前進。
お兄ちゃん！　
ソノ、
次の勝負も頑張るねっ！
さて
第二種目は……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, the next event is sumo? What kind of insane order is this? This organization makes no sense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
次の種目相撲かよ。
どんな順番だよ、
運営終わってんだろ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe it's a lucky chance for me? I'm not confident in my physical strength, but I'm certain that with everyone else being so full, they won't be able to move as they want to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
逆にラッキーか。
体力には自信ないけど、
みんなもお腹いっぱいだろうから
思う様に動けないだろうしさ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: WHA-...!? Are you serious? What's this, a kid's metabolism...? As I always say, kid's bodies are certainly amazing... if they were adults they'd be out of commission for another day minimum...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ……！？　
マジかよ
子どもの新陳代謝……
ほんと
子どもの体ってすごいな……
大人は胃もたれで
次の日まで動けないのに……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ughhh...
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐうう～……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I... I'm also in a kid's... no, a god's body right now. My metabolism... is the best.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ
私、
今
子どもの……
いや、
神の体だったわ。
代謝、
最高。

text_block_list.name: ソノ
text_block_list.text:
はあ……
勝った……
相撲……
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
勝った……
相撲……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I wasn't confident at all, but I won thanks to the basic specs inherited from this body... That Iroha's truly amazing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
正直全く自信なかったけど、
シンプルに
この体の基本スペックで勝っちゃった……
改めてすごいな
イロハ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Phew, however, I can say I've finally made it to the last event...! Just a little more, I'll give it everything...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう、
でもついに最終種目まできた……っ！
あと少し、
頑張るよ……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: A-Ahaha... Somehow, my knees are shaking. I guess that's what I get for not exercising enough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あはは……
なんか膝が笑ってる。
やっぱ
普段の運動不足が
たたってんのかな……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...! Even when I've come all this way...! My body...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ。
せっかくここまできたのに……っ。
体が……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: You're right... Or so I'd like to say, but I don't think that's possible... Haha. Guess that's my "adult's pride" speaking?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね……
って、
言いたいとこだけど。
それは無理かな……
はは。
大人の意地ってやつ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Don't do that. The rules don't prohibit it, but wouldn't that be cheating? I couldn't possibly hand the prize over to Iroha with a smile having done that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはダメ。
レギュレーションには載ってないけど、
インチキじゃない？
そんなんじゃ、
イロハに笑って賞品を渡せない。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll do what I can. No matter what the final event is... I'm going to... give it my all...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
やるだけやってみるよ。
最終種目がなんだろうと……
私の全てを……
全部出し尽くす……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hehe, conserving energy doesn't mean I'm lazy, you know? It means I'm saving my energy for when I really need it. For example, a day like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
省エネってのは
怠け者じゃないんだよ？
頑張らないといけないときのために
力をセーブしてるの。
たとえば今日みたいな日のために……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Adults, you see... they have days where they've got to look cool.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大人は、
かっこつけなきゃいけない日があるからさ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Staggering but determined, {0} watches Sono head off into battle. And then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふらふらになりながらも、
戦いへ赴くソノを見送る{0}。
そして……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Man, I was really worried back there for a second... but who'd have thought the final event to be an all-out math showdown!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー、
一時は
どうなることかと思ったけどさ～
まさか最終種目が
暗算勝負とは思わなかったわ～

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That is my specialty. I go head-to-head with numbers every single day, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これはさすがに無双だな。
こちとら毎日数字とにらめっこしてますから。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: So, how was it? The amazing power of the living abacus, Sono-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう？
ソロバンソノちゃんの実力は。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I know right? ...Wait, the smug look I had just now was like Rui-chan's... Forget it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
でしょ？
……
って
今のドヤ、
ルイちゃんぽかったな……
忘れて。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: But, I'm so glad...! I finally got that bug net!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
よかった……！
念願の虫取り網
ゲットしたよ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Mm. I know I’ve said it before, but it’s thanks to you that I could participate. Really, thank you... Onii-chan♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん。
改めてだけど、
君のおかげで出場できた。
本当にありがとう……
お兄ちゃん♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Later.
text_block_list.orig_text: 後日。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hm? Huh? Did I ask you to come work today? Ah... You're wondering about the bug net? I've got it right here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
あれ、
今日仕事頼んでたっけ？
ああ……
もしかして、
虫取り網？
それならここに置いてあるよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Nooope, quite the opposite. She says it's too precious to use for everyday stuff.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや～、
その逆。
なんか、
もったいなくて普段使いできないってさ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: She says it's her secret weapon, reserved for catching the biggest ones. Seriously... I really don’t know what she’s thinking.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大物狙う時に使う、
秘密兵器なんて言っててさ。
ほんと、
何考えてんだか。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hehe.
text_block_list.orig_text: ふふっ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Even as she said that, a smile filled with affection appeared on Sono's face. {0} couldn't help but smile in turn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言いながらも慈愛に満ちた笑みを浮かべるソノにつられ
{0}も笑顔を浮かべるのだった。
